title: Creamy French Mushroom Omelette
description: A simple and delicious omelette filled with sautéed French mushrooms and a hint of creaminess.
instructions: 1. Crack 2 eggs into a bowl and whisk until well combined.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
3. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
4. Pour in the whisked eggs and let the mixture set slightly.
5. Sprinkle the softened French cheese over the eggs.
6. Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the omelette towards the center.
7. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet.
8. Once the butter has melted, pour in the ethereal cream.
9. Use the spatula to carefully fold the omelette in half over the filling.
10. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through.
11. Slide the omelette onto a plate and serve hot.
